notes: CV dated March 16, 2020; only the two supplied files were used. w-523085 has an apparent title error: the graph says 1525-1657, the CV 1525-1650. Karim Baccouche (CV) and Alex Baccouche (graph) remain unmatched because these files do not establish identity. Kelly Chaves and Janet Mullin are explicitly co-supervised. Stephanie Pettegrew, Keith Grant, Leah Grandy, Amy O’Reilly, Janis Thiessen and Susan Meyer are only doctoral field/minor-field supervisions, retained in cv_only with that qualification. Examiners, readers and MA/honours supervisees are excluded. Publication statuses are in kind; null years mean no publication year is supplied, and submission deadlines are not publication dates. The Devil in the Reformations is dated approximately 2021. Nominal issue/imprint years are used despite delayed appearances; The Book That Changed Europe review uses 2013 for its 2012/13 issue, which appeared after July 2013. Jews and Muslims has a 2019 imprint but appeared November 2018. Explicit reprints, revised chapters, translations and the new Joris edition are separate entries; ordinary paperback reissues are omitted. Witch Hunt was revised in 2014 and 2018. Brackets disambiguate titles; two unnamed translated chapters are grouped without invented titles. The museum slide script is included as a listed research report. Presentations, grants, service, teaching and manuscript assessments are excluded. Amsterdamnified is a webpage/grant without a separately identified publication.
